DG-MCCP-PLATFORM-RUNNER-KEY.description: Exact OCI instance used by the Multi-Cloud Control Plane
DG-MCCP-PLATFORM-RUNNER-KEY.name: dg-mccp-platform-runner

PCY-MCCP-PLATFORM-RUNNER-STATE-KEY.description: Multi-Cloud Control Plane Terraform state access
PCY-MCCP-PLATFORM-RUNNER-STATE-KEY.name: pcy-mccp-platform-runner-state
statements: allow dynamic-group dg-mccp-platform-runner to read objectstorage-namespaces in tenancy
allow dynamic-group dg-mccp-platform-runner to read buckets in tenancy where target.bucket.name = '__STATE_BUCKET_NAME__'
allow dynamic-group dg-mccp-platform-runner to manage objects in tenancy where target.bucket.name = '__STATE_BUCKET_NAME__'
